workloads.question: How long does each file/size rung take to appear in the app, what long tasks and main-process stalls does it cause, and what do the CSV full read, long path list, large diff and background index refresh cost?
configuration: one app boot per family (a fatal rung is re-run around in a fresh boot, max 3 boots per group)
document ladders: CSV/XLSX/DOCX/HTML from the lab stress profile + CSV full read (5 MiB)
images: PNG and JPEG 1024x768, 2048x1536, 4096x3072 + the owner's original JPEG (byte copy)
fixtures generated by memory-bounded child processes

clocks.operation: performance.now() in the controller around the click-to-content action
clocks.longTasks: renderer and main event-loop probes (probe-loop.mjs, main-loop-probe.mjs), independent of the action clock

blindTo: software rendering only (llvmpipe under Xvfb): GPU paint cost
transcript-driven path list/diff, not composer typing or paste
background indexing measures the app's chat-history index, not a project file tree (none exists in source)
